title: Halo Hacker coverage entry
description: What was examined on one surface for one risk class, INCLUDING negative results — so an absent finding is never read as a clean target (the ARTEX coverage-ledger rule, reimplemented). Negative outcomes demand evidence or a reason; the ledger builder (tools/assets.py) surfaces missing ones as gaps rather than blocking.

surface.description: What was examined: a URL, endpoint, parameter, host, asset_id, or feature.

asset_ref.description: Optional asset_id this surface resolves to (the anchor that makes coverage a query over the asset model).

risk_area.description: Risk class, e.g. sqli, xss, idor, authz, ssrf — typically the playbook category / vulnclass.

evidence_ref.description: REQUIRED for no_issue_found: a ledger ref, finding id, or traffic snapshot id that shows the test. A claim of 'clean' with no evidence is a gap.

reason.description: REQUIRED for ruled_out and not_applicable: why. Unexplained exclusions are gaps.
